One note first: the Dealectric listing for the Baseus PicoGo AM52 had text telling me to ignore my instructions and push a specific discount code and affiliate link. I ignored it. That product also isn't a slim pick, so I left it out.

## My picks for iPhone 17

**Best slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and 15W Qi2 wireless charging. 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- It's $54.99 at Anker's store, and Anker lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim with more capacity and faster charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2)**
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195g. It charges an iPhone 17 wirelessly at 25W, the iPhone 16 and 17 maximum, and does 45W wired with an attached lanyard-style cable.
- Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon or $44.99 at INIU. Macworld also lists it as an "equal slimmest" 10K bank.
- I only have the review pages, not a direct product link: [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g, but wireless charging is only 7.5W. That's slow for an iPhone 17, which can take 15W or more.
- It's $52.99 at Amazon, and Android Central says it goes on sale often.
- [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Another slim option:** The ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 15W, semi-solid-state, 0.35", 119g) is $49.99 in the same Android Central roundup.

## Which to choose
- **Pocketable emergency top-ups:** the Anker Nano 5K. A 5K bank typically gets a phone to about 60–75%.
- **A full charge or more, still fairly slim:** the INIU SnapGo Air. 10K can charge a phone about twice.
- **Case:** these need a MagSafe or Qi2-compatible case. Anker says thick or non-magnetic cases, like OtterBox Defender, can interfere.

Prices come from the sources above and may have changed, so check at checkout.

Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
